# Modal

Use `modal/<model>` with VoltAgent's model router.

## Quick start

```ts
import { Agent } from "@voltagent/core";

const agent = new Agent({
  name: "modal-agent",
  instructions: "You are a helpful assistant",
  model: "modal/Qwen/Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B",
});
```

## Environment variables

- `MODAL_PROXY_TOKEN`

## Provider package

`@ai-sdk/openai-compatible`

This provider uses the OpenAI-compatible adapter.

## Default base URL

`https://inference.us-west.modal.direct/v1`

You can override the base URL by setting `MODAL_BASE_URL`.
